integrity: All exact formulas are proved by binomial-convolution identities and elementary real-variable arguments. The included program provides reproducible finite checks, not a substitute for the proof. No independent mathematical validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns unit-modulus coefficients on four Fourier frequencies, integer spacings at least four, and normalized eighth moments. It does not cover unrestricted amplitudes or arbitrary four-point supports. Historical priority outside inspected evidence remains open.
title: Quartic Fourier resonance and a non-cyclotomic optimal four-tone eighth moment
